Team —

Quick Q4 housekeeping: finance is running a close-of-quarter forecast roll-up this Friday and we have a handful of opportunities that look inconsistent between Stage, Close Date, and SFDC Last Modified. To avoid an overcommit, please do the following by EOD Thurs (Dec 4):

1) Run the attached Q4_pipeline_snapshot.csv filter for your region/AE and flag any opps that are "stale" (no activity in >30 days) or have close dates >45 days away but are still in Commit/Commit (Forecast category).
2) For any opp you still intend to include in the commit: update Stage to the correct Sales Stage, set a realistic Close Date, and add a one-line reason in the Opportunity Notes field (e.g., "Legal review pending, expected 12/22").
3) If this is a stretch and you want finance to exclude it from commit, mark the Deal as "Exclude from Forecast" and ping me with a one-line rationale.

Key reminders: only mark "Commit" in the forecast when you have a confirmed exec sponsor + signed next step (PO/contract in hand or DocuSign in progress). Close dates padded more than 2 weeks from the last client activity will be rolled to next quarter unless you flag them.

Attachments: Q4_pipeline_snapshot.csv (per-AE snapshot)

Let me know if you need a quick help session to triage — I can hop on a 15-min sync this afternoon.

Thanks,
Neha
